name: scan_text
description: Scan text for prompt injection, data exfiltration, credential leaks and other AI agent security threats. Returns findings, a severity and a decision. The decision is reported, not enforced.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: The text content to scan for security threats.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.desc: The input channel type (message, file, api_response, web_content, log_memory, tool_output, agent_input, code, prompt). Default message.

name: scan_file
description: Scan a file for prompt injection and security threats.

arguments.name: file_path
arguments.desc: Absolute path to the file to scan. Must be inside a configured path.

arguments.name: allow_deep
arguments.desc: Allow slow DEEP scans for audio/video files. Default false.

name: scanner_info
description: Get scanner info: version, pattern count, keyword count, supported channels.
